question: Which of the following peptides are not produced by the renal system?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Renin" -> "produced by juxtaglomerular cells in kidneys" -> 0%
CHAIN: "Angiotensin I" -> "formed from angiotensinogen by renin" -> "renin produced by kidneys" -> 0%
CHAIN: "Erythropoietin" -> "produced by kidneys in response to hypoxia" -> 0%
CHAIN: "1,25DHCC" -> "active form of vitamin D" -> "synthesized in kidneys from 25-hydroxyvitamin D" -> 0%
analysis: Renin, Angiotensin I, and Erythropoietin are all peptides associated with the renal system. Renin is produced by the kidneys and is involved in the regulation of blood pressure. Angiotensin I is a precursor molecule formed by the action of renin on angiotensinogen. Erythropoietin, also produced by the kidneys, stimulates red blood cell production. However, 1,25-Dihydroxycholecalciferol (1,25DHCC), also known as calcitriol, is the active form of vitamin D, primarily synthesized in the kidneys but not a peptide; it is a secosteroid hormone.
